evidence.detail: typeahead search does only exact string match and substring (q in name), no Levenshtein/fuzzy matching; 'fire ice' would not find 'Fire // Ice'
FuzzyTerm-based whoosh search exists and handles fuzzy matching but is only used by the Discord bot, not the web typeahead

triage.notes: Connecting whoosh to the web typeahead endpoint requires either rewriting init_search_cache to run queries through WhooshSearch per keystroke (latency concern) or building a fuzzy-normalized alternate-name index into typeahead.json at build time.
